handbook.categories.additions: Learn more about the XP Obelisk Additions!
gui.xps_additions.xp_enchanter.cost: Needs obelisk level %s, costs %s levels + %s lapis
gui.xps_additions.xp_enchanter.status.no: No XP Obelisk next to it
page.text.xp_enchanter: An enchanting table that runs on stored experience instead of your own.$(br2)Place it next to an XP Obelisk, put the item into the upper slot and lapis lazuli below it. Pick the level with the $(o)-$() and $(o)+$() buttons, hold shift to jump by ten.$(br2)Press $(o)Enchant$() or send the block a redstone pulse. Hoppers fill both input slots and pull the finished item back out.
page.text.xp_enchanter_cost: The obelisk has to hold as much experience as a player of the chosen level would have, and the enchant then takes exactly what that player would pay.$(br2)That is $(o)1$() level and one lapis up to level 10, $(o)2$() up to level 20 and $(o)3$() up to level 30.$(br2)Books come out as enchanted books, everything the vanilla table accepts works here as well.
